text:
olivia_csm: we need a 1-pager 'launch tidy-sheet' for customers — short, actionable, focused on prefill sampling, adaptive batching, streaming fallback, and renewal risk signals. must be copyable into emails.
kevin_eng: ok. ill keep it tight: 5-step checklist + 2 tiny snippets (customer and infra) + 3 ops watchlines.
rachel_cs: customers want one clear ask to approve. include a 1-line customer consent they can paste.
olivia_csm: suggested consent line: 'Please approve a 30-minute launch run to warm instances and populate common caches so end-users see fast responses.'
kevin_eng: customer-facing checklist (copyable):
1) Preflight: validate API keys, quota, and pin model version.
2) Consent: customer approves a 30-min launch run.
3) Sampling: run prefill of ~25 representative flows (include long prefixes if relevant).
4) Stabilize: maintain warm_instances >= 2 for first 2 hours, enable caching for hot prefixes.
5) Verify: run 5 product-critical transactions (golden tests) and report latency + UX issues.
sam_sre: runtime guidance to paste into ops: use adaptive batching profile for mixed traffic, keep streaming on for human-facing flows but ensure connection limits. fallback policy: if connection errors exceed 2% of requests in 10m -> disable streaming and switch to short-polling.
kevin_eng: small infra snippet customers can hand to platform team:
```yaml
launch_run:
  enabled: true
  prefill_count: 25
  warm_instances: 2
serving:
  batching:
    profile: adaptive
    max_requests: 8
    window_ms: 50
  streaming: true
  cache:
    hot_prefix_ttl: 600
```
rachel_cs: customer email blurb (one line): "Wed like 30 minutes to run a short traffic sample to warm instances and cache common prefixes so your users get consistent performance at launch."
sam_sre: ops watchlines (console queries and product signals):
- infra: `sum(rate(inference_errors_total{tenant=\"${tenant}\"}[5m]))`
- perf: `avg_over_time(latency_ms{model=\"${model}\"}[5m])`
- product: `success_rate(transaction=\"checkout\", window=1h)` (replace transaction with customer-critical flow)
also watch product KPIs: drop in conversion or spike in support tickets.
kevin_eng: escalation thresholds we recommend adding to alerts:
- infra errors > baseline*3 for 10m -> page eng-oncall
- product-critical success rate drops >= 25% over 1h -> notify AM + open ticket
- avg latency >= baseline*2 for 20m -> trigger fallback (route: smaller-model) + page oncall
sam_sre: recommended remediation order (copyable):
1) confirm model pin and revert to prior if quality regressed
2) verify warm_instances and prefill completed
3) switch batching.profile to conservative (reduce max_requests) to lower tail latency
4) toggle streaming=false if connection failures persist
5) route a percentage of traffic to a smaller model as temporary fallback
opsbot: created internal launch job template -> /ops/templates/launch-tidy-job.yaml :white_check_mark:
rachel_cs: post-run feedback snippet for customers to paste back: "We ran the launch run — please execute 5 representative flows and reply: 1) Outputs as expected? (Y/N) 2) Avg latency observed (ms) 3) Any errors/timeouts or odd completions?"
olivia_csm: renewal-risk play: check 48h and 7-day windows; if product-critical success_rate stays below threshold after 72h -> schedule AM+CSM 1:1; if still unresolved escalate to Solutions Eng and propose temporary pause of new user onboarding.
everyone: fine to publish as the tidy-sheet. tagging @kevin_eng @sam_sre for final tech sign-off.
kevin_eng: looks good to me.
sam_sre: fine, will add alert rule snippets to runbook repo after publish.
olivia_csm: thanks all 496 will format and drop the one-pager into the customer playbook.
opsbot: noted: runbook PR created -> /runbooks/onboarding/launch-tidy-sheet.md :white_check_mark:
